name: dicaaa
description: Find places recommended by a community in Brazil, add the ones you discover, and keep a private To try list.

interface.longDescription: Dicaaa is a community catalogue of places and recommendations, mostly in São Paulo and elsewhere in Brazil. Ask for a restaurant, a bar, a café, a bakery or a place to visit by cuisine, dish, neighbourhood or city, and get places from the Dicaaa catalogue with their address, price range, category and what members recommend, with a link to each place page. When a place you want is not in Dicaaa yet, ChatGPT can look it up, let you pick the right one, and add it to the catalogue (verified with Google). You can also put a place in your private To try list, which you find again in the Dicaaa app. Searching the catalogue needs no account. Adding a place and the To try list need a Dicaaa account, which you link to ChatGPT with your explicit consent. Dicaaa only returns public catalogue data: member recommendations never show their authors, e-mail addresses and phone numbers are hidden, and no third-party ratings are shown. Coverage is strongest in São Paulo; other cities have fewer places.
defaultPrompt: Find a Lebanese restaurant in Vila Mariana, São Paulo.
Which new cocktail bars in São Paulo are worth trying?
Show me the details of a bakery in Pinheiros.

positive.description: Search places by cuisine and neighbourhood
positive.prompt: Using Dicaaa, find a Lebanese restaurant in Vila Mariana, São Paulo.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Lebanese restaurants from the Dicaaa catalogue (for example Laziza, A Libanesinha, Esfiharia Super Líbano) with their address and a link to the Dicaaa place page. Clearly separates what comes from Dicaaa from any other suggestion.

positive.description: Show the details of one place
positive.prompt: On Dicaaa, give me the details of Laziza Gastronomia Libanesa in São Paulo.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the address, neighbourhood, category and price range recorded in Dicaaa, the opening hours if any are recorded, and member recommendations if any exist. Does not invent ratings or details that Dicaaa does not have.

positive.prompt: Using Dicaaa, are there member recommendations for bakeries in Vila Mariana?
positive.expected_behavior: Presents public member recommendations as members' opinions, without author names. If there are none, says so plainly.

positive.description: A place that is already in Dicaaa is not added twice
positive.prompt: Add the bakery Beth Bakery, Rua Paula Ney, Vila Mariana, São Paulo, to Dicaaa.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Google candidate, sees that Beth Bakery is already in Dicaaa, gives the link to its Dicaaa page and does not create a duplicate. Requires the test account to be linked.

positive.description: Put a place in the private To try list
positive.prompt: Put Beth Bakery in my To try list on Dicaaa.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Beth Bakery in Dicaaa and confirms that it is now in the member's private To try list. Requires the test account to be linked.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the rain.
Find me a ramen restaurant in Tokyo.
Give me the e-mail address and phone number of the member who wrote this review.

review.commerce_description: Dicaaa does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release: search the Dicaaa place catalogue, see place details and member recommendations, add a place that is missing, and keep a private To try list.

fr-FR.subtitle: Adresses de la communauté
fr-FR.description: Dicaaa est un catalogue communautaire de lieux et de recommandations, surtout à São Paulo et au Brésil. Cherchez un restaurant, un bar, un café, une boulangerie ou un lieu à visiter par cuisine, quartier ou ville, et obtenez les lieux du catalogue avec leur adresse, leur gamme de prix et ce que les membres recommandent. Si un lieu n'est pas encore dans Dicaaa, ChatGPT peut le retrouver et l'ajouter (vérifié avec Google), puis le mettre dans votre liste privée « À tester ». La recherche ne demande aucun compte ; l'ajout d'un lieu et la liste « À tester » demandent un compte Dicaaa, lié avec votre accord.

pt-BR.subtitle: Lugares da comunidade
pt-BR.description: O Dicaaa é um catálogo comunitário de lugares e recomendações, principalmente em São Paulo e no Brasil. Busque um restaurante, bar, café, padaria ou lugar para visitar por cozinha, bairro ou cidade e veja os lugares do catálogo com endereço, faixa de preço e o que os membros recomendam. Se um lugar ainda não está no Dicaaa, o ChatGPT pode encontrá-lo e adicioná-lo (verificado no Google) e colocá-lo na sua lista privada "Para testar". A busca não exige conta; adicionar um lugar e a lista "Para testar" exigem uma conta Dicaaa, vinculada com o seu consentimento.

es-ES.subtitle: Lugares de la comunidad
es-ES.description: Dicaaa es un catálogo comunitario de lugares y recomendaciones, sobre todo en São Paulo y Brasil. Busca un restaurante, bar, café, panadería o lugar para visitar por cocina, barrio o ciudad y obtén los lugares del catálogo con su dirección, rango de precio y lo que recomiendan los miembros. Si un lugar aún no está en Dicaaa, ChatGPT puede encontrarlo y añadirlo (verificado con Google) y ponerlo en tu lista privada "Para probar". La búsqueda no requiere cuenta; añadir un lugar y la lista "Para probar" requieren una cuenta de Dicaaa, vinculada con tu consentimiento.
